rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) is straightforward property damage to the home's exterior.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; four shingles blown off with no interior water damage. Estimated repair cost $400. Low-severity claim requiring roofing contractor quote.

case_facts.description: wind damage - four shingles blown off
